# Contract: Create Post

## Overview

This contract defines the expected behavior for creating a new post.

## Request

POST /api/posts
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json

```json
{
  "content": "Exciting new post content generated by AI!",
  "status": "DRAFT"
}
```

## Success Response (201 Created)

Content-Type: application/json

```json
{
  "post": {
    "id": "post_id",
    "content": "Exciting new post content generated by AI!",
    "status": "DRAFT",
    "userId": "user_id",
    "createdAt": "2025-10-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

## Error Responses

### 401 Unauthorized

```json
{
  "error": "Authentication required"
}
```

### 400 Bad Request - Empty Content

```json
{
  "error": "Content cannot be empty"
}
```

## Business Rules

- User must be authenticated
- Content must not be empty
- Status defaults to DRAFT if not provided
- Post is associated with the authenticated user
